_comment: Teams set by hand, keyed by the player name exactly as it appears in player-pool-2026.json. Since 2026-09-18 an entry here WINS over nba.com's roster (resolveTeams.js): it is how a move the cached roster does not show yet — an offseason trade — reaches the card (Kawhi Leonard to Toronto and Brandon Ingram to the Clippers, both 2026-09-18: "Can you change the Kawhi Leonard 26-27 card to the Raptors? He was traded."; Ingram went the other way in the same deal). A player on NO roster is a free agent (FA) since 2026-10-14 (the user: "If they're unlisted, you can remove them from their teams"), so do not pin an unsigned player to his old club here: Tyrese Martin, Gabe Vincent and Rob Dillingham were pinned that way on 2026-10-02 and came out the day the rule came in. null is the same as no entry. After an edit, run generateTeams.js (or edit player-teams-2026.json to match) and generateCards.js, then re-export the face.
